EC1: - Prior surgical procedures involving heart surgery [OR] and cardiopulmonary bypass
EC2: - Any prior documented history of atrial fibrillation, [OR] atrial flutter [OR] or atrial tachycardia lasting longer than 30 seconds
EC3: - Prior history of Amiodarone treatment for the management of supraventricular tachy-arrhythmias
EC4: - Patients requiring surgical treatment of atrial arrhythmias such as pulmonary vein isolation [OR] or Maze procedure.
